units: cell frame: m, origin = the arm base, z up, x towards the positioner's drive stand; vehicle frame B: mm, FLU (x forward, y port, z up), origin on the 4-inch tube axis; yaw / roll in deg

conventions.psi_deg: 0 = the vehicle's stern towards the arm (vehicle x = cell x); keel_up = 180 deg about the vehicle x axis
conventions.station_frames: ballast_box: middle of the pocket field on the bench; thruster_tray: middle of the 4 nests on the bench; enclosure_rack: midway between the two V blocks on the bench, x along the tube axis; guard_rack: centre of the shelf's top face, x along the guard's long side (both racks yaw 0: the guard lies in its vehicle orientation, front towards +x, outer edge outboard)
conventions.jitter: per episode, uniform: x and y each within +-jitter_xy_m, yaw within +-jitter_yaw_deg (the ballast box is fixed; the L-mag lever, P10, is off)

validity.method: jitter envelope = union over yaw (1 deg samples, consecutive samples hulled) of the Minkowski sum of each convex footprint piece (station boxes; convex hulls of the parts' coarse hi samples) with the jitter square; shapely distances

provenance.design: DESIGN.md v1.2 section 1.3 (placement, positioner, stations) with DECISIONS L13, L19, N5; PHASE2_PLAN P06 notes
digest_derived_at_run_time: fork jaws: side-plate end edges and faces, guard ends (manifest bboxes)
column x range: the vehicle's x extent
ballast pockets: the block's own footprint (min-area rectangle of its hi mesh) + play
thruster nests: the duct's bottom edge (hi samples) sits on the ring top
enclosure rack: the tube axis frame E (P02 unit map), the rack origin at E x = midway between the two 4-inch cradles
guard racks: the guard's bbox (width, bottom face), its inner edge on the shelf
